mapper.insert: INSERT INTO proveedor (persona_id, usuario_id, empresa, latitud, longitud, radio_cobertura_km, descripcion, verificado, calificacion) VALUES (#{personaId}, #{usuarioId}, #{empresa}, #{latitud}, #{longitud}, #{radioCoberturaKm}, #{descripcion}, #{verificado}, #{calificacion})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM proveedor pr WHERE pr.id = #{id} AND pr.deleted = FALSE

pr.deleted = FALSE AND (p.nombre ILIKE '%' || #{nombre} '%' OR p.primer_apellido ILIKE '%' || #{nombre} '%' OR pr.empresa ILIKE '%' || #{nombre} '%')

SELECT FROM proveedor pr INNER JOIN proveedor_especialidad pe ON pe.proveedor_id = pr.id AND pe.deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN servicio s ON s.id = pe.servicio_id AND s.deleted = FALSE WHERE pe.servicio_id = #{servicioId} AND pr.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY pr.created_at ASC

SELECT , (6371 * acos( cos(radians(#{latitud})) * cos(radians(pr.latitud)) * cos(radians(pr.longitud) - radians(#{longitud})) + sin(radians(#{latitud})) * sin(radians(pr.latitud)) )) AS distancia FROM proveedor pr WHERE pr.deleted = FALSE AND pr.latitud IS NOT NULL AND pr.longitud IS NOT NULL AND (6371 * acos( cos(radians(#{latitud})) * cos(radians(pr.latitud)) * cos(radians(pr.longitud) - radians(#{longitud})) + sin(radians(#{latitud})) * sin(radians(pr.latitud)) )) <= #{radioKm} ORDER BY distancia ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
